_documentation.purpose: Content for the site-wide audience side-drawer (the recurring 'Start where you are' role-router). Rendered at runtime by the IIFE at the foot of assets/js/site.js, which injects a right-edge tab and a <dialog> drawer on every page. Locale is read from <html lang>; falls back to 'en'.
_documentation.editing: Copy mirrors the inline #audiences section on index.html / .fr / .de. Keep the two in step. Same-page anchors (#for-members, #news) are stored as absolute per-locale URLs (index.<loc>.html#...) so they resolve from any page, not just the homepage.
_documentation.icons: Each card's 'icon' key maps to an inline Lucide SVG in site.js (researcher, policy, member, press). Add a new key there before using it here.
_documentation.translation: FR/DE are hand-translated (CLAUDE.md §1). No machine translation.
